records_captured: Checks and Counters from the same files: per Pokémon, its MAX_COUNTERS (20) strongest checks by p - 4d

fields.name: month
fields.description: The month the statistics cover, YYYY-MM

fields.name: metagame
fields.description: Smogon's metagame slug, the regulation registry's munchstats_format ("gen9championsvgc2026regmc")

fields.name: regulation_code
fields.description: The registered regulation the file belongs to (dbt/seeds/champions_regulations.csv)

fields.name: variant
fields.description: bo1 or bo3: the Showdown ladder the battles were played on

fields.name: cutoff
fields.description: Rating floor: 1760 weights each battle by the chance its players are rated above 1760; 0 counts every battle equally

fields.name: pokemon_name
fields.description: Showdown display name ("Charizard-Mega-Y"); mapped to pokemon_key by int_smogon_ladder_mapped

fields.name: counter_name
fields.description: The opponent, as a Showdown display name

fields.name: encounters
fields.description: Weighted times the two met and one was KO'd or switched out (Smogon's n). Kept only from MIN_COUNTER_ENCOUNTERS (100)

fields.name: ko_or_switch_rate
fields.description: Share of those encounters in which this Pokémon (not the opponent) was KO'd or switched out (Smogon's p)

fields.name: std_dev
fields.description: Standard deviation of ko_or_switch_rate (Smogon's d); Smogon ranks by p - 4d

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The chaos JSON file the row comes from

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Unique row id within the source: month/file:Pokémon[:opponent or spread]

known_risks: Smogon lists a pair only above about 20 encounters, and the 1760 files weight encounters by rating, so those files carry almost none: read cutoff 0
Pokémon vs Pokémon on the ladder, not tournament data, which is team vs team
